name: BANGYA Simulator
source:
[i]Have you ever heard about Visual Kei?[/i]

BANGYA Simulator is a Visual Kei themed visual novel with dating sim elements. 

Experience being a fan of unpopular vkei band, going to live concerts, meeting your favorite bandman, making friends with other fans and more!
